evidence.observation: O2 at 3.3 ppm, near the post-purge baseline of about 5 ppm
O2 rose steadily from 11.6 to 32.4 ppm over t=2760-3120 during growth, with no change in setpoints
Pressure steady at about 760 Torr, so an exhaust blockage is unlikely
Ar flow on setpoint at about 100 sccm, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
Temperature holding at 750 °C with plausible heater power

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (for example, isolating the tube and watching pressure/O2) would confirm the seal leak. There is no reference band to show how far O2 is from normal during growth. No sample characterization yet.
